SELECT a.repositoryId, al.language, SUM(al.lines) AS totalLines, ROUND( SUM(al.lines) * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(al.lines)) OVER (PARTITION BY a.repositoryId), 2 ) AS percentage FROM analysis a JOIN analysisLanguage al ON a.id = al.analyzeId WHERE a.repositoryId = #{repositoryId} GROUP BY a.repositoryId, al.language ORDER BY totalLines DESC

SELECT id, repositoryId, diffId, coverage, totalScore, bugs, complexity, codeSmells, duplicatedLinesDensity, vulnerabilities, analyzeDate FROM analysis WHERE repositoryId = #{repoId} AND analyzeDate >= ( SELECT DATE_SUB(MAX(analyzeDate), INTERVAL 14 DAY) FROM analysis WHERE repositoryId = #{repoId} ) ORDER BY analyzeDate ASC
